fully_connected.label: Fully connected
fully_connected.description: Every member can send permitted information to every other member.

hub_and_spoke.label: Hub and spoke
hub_and_spoke.description: Member 1 is the two-way communication hub; spokes exchange through it.

ring.label: Ring · two-way
ring.description: Each member connects to its two neighbors in a bidirectional ring.

hierarchical.label: Hierarchical routing
hierarchical.description: A bidirectional binary-tree communication layout; it does not grant decision authority.

chain.label: Chain · two-way
chain.description: Adjacent member IDs exchange in both directions along a path, without a closing loop.

directed_chain.label: Chain · one-way
directed_chain.description: Information can flow from member 1 toward the last member, one adjacent hop at a time; no reverse links.

directed_ring.label: Ring · one-way
directed_ring.description: Each member sends to the next member, with the last sending to member 1; reverse links are not implied.

wheel.label: Wheel
wheel.description: Member 1 is a two-way hub; the remaining members also form a bidirectional outer ring.

grid.label: Grid
grid.description: A row-major near-square grid with two-way horizontal and vertical neighbors, no diagonals or wraparound.

clustered.label: Clustered pods
clustered.description: Consecutive groups of up to three members are fully connected; each pod's first member links bidirectionally to the next pod's first member.

bipartite.label: Bipartite
bipartite.description: The first ceil(N/2) members connect bidirectionally to all remaining members; no within-partition links.

broadcast.label: Broadcast · one-to-many
broadcast.description: Member 1 can send to every other member; no replies or spoke-to-spoke routes are implied.

gather.label: Gather · many-to-one
gather.description: Every other member can send to member 1; no return or spoke-to-spoke routes are implied.

custom.label: Custom directed links
custom.description: Only the explicitly declared directed links exist; reverse links are not implied.
